edition.publication: Princeton: Princeton University Press; London: Humphrey Milford, Oxford University Press, 1919
edition.title: Sancti Augustini Vita Scripta a Possidio Episcopo: Revised Text and Translation

work.author: Possidius of Calama
work.description: The contemporary Life of Augustine of Hippo written by his friend and fellow bishop Possidius of Calama within the decade after Augustine's death (after the Vandal withdrawal from Hippo in 431), with an appended Indiculus of Augustine's writings. It is the principal external witness to Augustine's clerical life, episcopate, daily practice, last illness, and death.
work.title: Vita Augustini
